summary: IHS Holding Limited furnished a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual general meeting held October 8, 2026. Holders of 260,048,338 ordinary shares as of the August 25, 2026 record date were represented, constituting a quorum, and voting proceeded by poll with one vote per share, subject to the Articles' limitations. The sole proposal, electing Sam Darwish, William Saad, Ursula Burns, John Ellis Bush, Maria Carolina Lacerda, Nicholas Land, Phuthuma Nhleko and Aniko Szigetvari as directors until the 2027 AGM, was approved. No special-situation event or deal terms are present.
